evidence.reason: Changed to applyDiscount(amount + 1, 0.1), injecting an extra +1 into the discounted amount, which no caller or test expects.
Changed from price*(1-rate) to price-rate, altering the discount contract from proportional to absolute subtraction.
assert.equal(applyDiscount(100, 0.1), 90) fails under the new subtractive implementation (99.9).
assert.equal(cart.total(), 18) and checkout(cart) === 'USD 18.00' fail because total() now returns 18.9.
assert.equal(new SeasonalRule().apply(100), 80) fails because applyDiscount(100, 0.2) now returns 99.8.
checkout passes cart.total() to formatMoney; the merged total is wrong, so checkout output is wrong.
PriceRule.apply relies on applyDiscount(price, 0.1) semantics, which changed from proportional to subtractive.
SeasonalRule.apply relies on applyDiscount(price, 0.2) semantics, which changed from proportional to subtractive.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改叠加后破坏了折扣语义，导致购物车总价、折扣函数和季节规则的计算结果都与调用方和测试预期不符。
result.suggestedAction: 请将 src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount 恢复为 price * (1 - rate)，并将 src/cart.ts#Cart.total 中的 applyDiscount(amount + 1, 0.1) 改回 applyDiscount(amount, 0.1)。
